translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: 「うーむ、なんかこうしてみると不気味だな。

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: 「Huh? There are even JAPAN samurai...」

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: 「A daimyo from JAPAN... um, in local terms that would be

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: like a regional noble, I think...」
